corpus.rule: only games whose official label is Final are used; a game still live at capture time is excluded, never filled in

measured.why: the rho a same-game side-and-total parlay needs
overtime raises the total without moving the margin the same way, so the regulation-only figure is the cleaner estimate

not_measurable.quantity: rho between two different games on the same date
not_measurable.why_not: two games have no natural pairing, so a number would be an artefact of how the pairs were made rather than a property of the games
not_measurable.consequence: cross-game parlays are published as the naive product p1 x p2 with the Frechet-Hoeffding band [max(0, p1+p2-1), min(p1, p2)]; no rho is asserted

not_measurable.quantity: rho between a model pick and a market price
not_measurable.why_not: no NBA-operated source publishes a price, so there is no market leg to correlate

home_win_rate.note: this is the measured home-win rate the brief asks to pin home-court advantage to; it is published here and is NOT applied to any originated line yet (flag F-W02 / F74)
